To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the announcement of proposed heavy vehicle route had a statistically significant and economically meaningful effect on property values, with the magnitude of the effect declining with distance from the proposed heavy vehicle routes.

the announcement of the project caused property values in the study area to fall by 3.7% and that the marginal impact of the announcement was $17,020 per property for each additional kilometre of distance between the property and the project.

the marginal willingness-to-pay for properties within a distance of 5 km from the proposed heavy vehicle freight route declined by $17,020 per kilometer after the proposed heavy vehicle project was announced.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact on property values of a project announcement that is potentially controversial.
the impact of the announcement of a major infrastructure development project on property values in the affected area.

the property value impacts from the announcement of a project with potential environmental impacts, and the hypothesis is that the property market in the affected area experiences uncertainty from such an announcement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the announcement of projects with the potential to cause environmental impact creates uncertainty which can be measured in property markets.
there are significant and measurable negative impacts of the announcement of a major infrastructure project on property values in the affected area.
the results indicate that the marginal value of property declines by AU$17.02 per km proximity to a heavy vehicle route after the route is announced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results indicate that the announcement of projects with potential impacts creates uncertainty, which is a cost to property owners.
the results of this paper provide a basis for the development of a methodology for the measurement of property value impacts of project announcements.
the announcement of the project has the potential to reduce property values by AU$17 per km of proximity to the route.
The main takeaway from our work is that
property value impacts should be considered in cost–benefit analyses of projects that are likely to have environmental impacts.
there are significant costs of uncertainty associated with the development of projects that have potential environmental impacts.
the property market responds to project announcements, and the impact is not limited to the project’s construction and operating phase.
